Before the Nov 3 midterms: buy-and-hold the index rather than bet the night. SPY was higher 12 months after all six midterms since 2002 (+4% to +17%, research/MIDTERMS-2026.md), against 78% of all 12-month windows since 2000; the 75% is near that base rate, not an election edge. Options price Wednesday's move at about 0.9%, close to past midterms' 1.1%, so no event bet

Midterm play: likeliest direct winner of a Democratic Congress (largest ACA marketplace + Medicaid insurer; Democrats promise to restore the expired ACA credits). Q3 beat and raised guide (Oct 28), Wells Fargo target 75; up 12% in a month, down 4% Nov 2 on pre-vote profit-taking with no bad news. Much is priced (Dem House ~93%), and a Republican Senate (~30%) would hurt, so only a slight lean

Midterm play: hospitals gain from more insured patients if Democrats restore ACA credits. Tenet beat and raised its 2026 outlook (Oct 29-31), Wells Fargo target 321 (Nov 2); up 49% in 6 months, down 5% Nov 2 on pre-vote profit-taking. Priced in part, and a Republican Senate (~30%) would hurt, so only a slight lean

Can Centene close at or above $70 on Friday after the midterms? Options price 22% at the Nov 6 expiry (IV 58%); a scenario simulation (Democrats win both 70%: about +4% Wednesday; split Congress 25%: about -6.5%; Republicans keep both 5%: about -14%) gives 25%, 36% if Democrats win both and about 1% otherwise

Midterm loser lean: a Democratic House controls the ICE detention budget and oversight; GEO fell 5.2% and 4.9% against SPY the day after the 2018 and 2022 midterms and 10.6% on Jan 27 when Senate Democrats opposed DHS funding (Reuters). A Democratic win is ~70-93% priced, a Republican Senate (~30%) would lift it, and earnings on Nov 5 add noise: only a slight lean, expected value near zero
